limitations: Different repeat-annotation software/library versions remain a confounder; differences are annotation-fragment candidates, not proven insertion polymorphisms.
GCA and GCF CHM13 assemblies are explicitly not identical. Use the selected GenBank/author analysis-set sequence only.
HG002 is one maternal haplotype of one donor, not a diploid/population comparison.
HG002 bigRmsk visualization spans include unaligned flanks/gaps; recover original fragment coordinates from description rows, never BED visualization extents.

Four annotation assets have no published full-object MD5 in reviewed metadata; multipart S3 ETags are not MD5. Fetch with HTTPS, record exact byte sizes and local SHA256; do not invent provider checksums.
HG002 v1.1 is deliberately pinned to the assembly version with matching Liftoff and repeat annotations; newer project assemblies are not substituted.

Joined HG002 browser records can contain mixed original fragment orientations; use the standalone extracted RepeatMasker input. The frozen direct bigRmsk parser rejects these valid complex joins and must not be used for this dataset.
source_coverage_note: All 5,422,582 original RepeatMasker fragments from all 4,480,264 selected bigRmsk records are preserved. Ordered full-field hashes and per-chromosome counts match the original source; each output maps to its source row and fragment index.

upstream_annotation_qc.action: Recover all original RepeatMasker fields and fragment orientations without changing coordinates, merging, deduplicating or filtering. One original fragment extends one base left of its browser aligned-summary interval; the exact original end+remaining length agrees with the selected FASTA.
